en.bdb: The result of company of an apostate

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੇਡੈ ਪੂਛਲਿ ਲਗਿਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: bheddai poochhal lagiaa(n) kiau paar la(n)gheeaai|

en.bdb: How one could get across the water by catching hold of the tail of a sheep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਤੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਜੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: bhootai keree dhosatee nit sahasaa jeeaai|

en.bdb: Friendship with a ghost is always a source of suspicious life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: nadhee kinaarai rukhaRaa vesaahu naa keeaai|

en.bdb: The tree on a river bank cannot have the faith (that the river will not perish it).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੀਆਹੀਐ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਥੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: mritak naal veeaaheeaai sohaag na theeaai|

en.bdb: How a woman married to a dead person could be said to be a suhagin, i.e one whose husband is alive.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਬੀਜਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਲਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: vis halaahal beej kai kiau amiau laheeaai|

en.bdb: How nectar could be obtained by sowing poison.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh setee pirahaRee jam dda(n)dd saheeaai ||7||

en.bdb: The friendship with an apostate brings the sufferings of the rod of Yama.
